name: Search directory
descriptor: A search box with focus, and cards underneath. For a list you look things up in rather than read.
verify_checks: directory: the search box is enlarged and focused
pros: the cursor is already in the box, so the first keystroke is the search
matches are highlighted, so you see why a card came back
cards fit more per record than a row does
no toolbar to learn: one box and a list
cons: search is still a linear scan, so it is not a real index
nothing is shown until you type, which looks empty to a first-time user
no sort and no filters: this view deliberately has one control
cards are taller, so fewer records fit on a screen
best_for: a few hundred records you look up by name
avoid_if: you need to browse, sort, or see everything at once
